purpose: Connect all six frozen pre-B mean decisions to original closed deployment receipts; no new scientific evaluation or model prediction.
reads: Exact approved source/contract/master/config/inventory/job-manifest and config frozen_artifacts files; files are hashed, not imported.
Original per-group pre-B decisions, FINAL_EXECUTION_LINK or ERROR or OWNER_CLOSE, existing original branch sidecars and referenced attempts/*_RESULT.json metadata.

runtime/ATTEMPTS.jsonl as an original metadata stream; only lines containing the exact group token are JSON-decoded and only matching group START/END records are retained. No other group result is opened.
Optional original lambda1 raw-equivalence audit JSON only; a/b are checked as identity strings, physical raw directories are never opened.
Frozen closed GateC/GateL/GateG RESULT JSON policies for canonical policy/weight hashing only; no normalization, dot product or prediction.
Main's actual closed-owner review and original process metadata plus /proc/<pid>/stat identity/exit checks.
checks: Six ordered pre-B labels; 6 logical copies and deploy_mean entries; returned+numerical-rejected=6; returned<=actual internal forward delta<=6; actual seven-role/causal39/25 projection counters=1; recorded restore/init/fit/RNG/sample/physics=0.

Seven loaded-role hashes and paths equal original proof audit, original job source manifest, original config and approved current immutable source bytes; proof records current-task B/results unused and callback checked.

All six canonical policy SHA and weight SHA from exact frozen endpoints; every normal prediction binds that policy and its full recipe/action SHA; numerical rejection is explicitly B fallback without model qualification.

Exact full-recipe aliases into the original fixed plan; lambda1 is an independent paid repeat of original EARLY_H150, never a static physical alias. Shared deployment receipts are not independent replications or attempt savings.
All existing known plan branch sidecars must be included, with exact original result path/SHA, original START/END raw-line SHA, config SHA, joined=True and parent_hash_equal=True.

Preserve the original eleven hard-condition fields and derive only the same three-valued metadata flag: any false or original explicit hard=True gives true; all eleven true gives false; otherwise UNKNOWN. No new scorer and no global safety claim.

If any unique mean physically started: original B complete+qualified; H150 complete (qualification is not a filter); independent lambda1 complete; all three original hard flags false; original full raw-equivalence gate PASS with exact H/lambda paths and original JF/JM/axes/qualification equality.

Missing branch receipt with original START is ATTEMPTED_BUT_MISSING_CLOSED_RECEIPT, never NOT_RUN. No START permits NOT_RUN. Original complete-unqualified, partial, error, UNKNOWN and STOP remain visible.

counts.metadata_JSON_decodes_hashes_event_decod: actual counters, not model API calls
counts.original_API_counts: copied without recomputation from pre-B actual_counts
counts.original_native_cost: original END.native_steps by attempt, including parent separately; no parent+child double-counted total is invented

writes: Only this new report directory's outputs/<group>_ONCE_V1/{START,REPORT,DONE,FAILED}.json using exclusive creation; source preparation creates no real approval or output.
failure: Preserve paid START/counts/FAILED if possible, no retry, no success imputation, no source/model/config adjustment.
limits: This is an audit of original metadata and frozen provenance, not an independent recomputation of pre-B causal observations, scorer, raw equality or forward values.
Closure rests on exact independently reviewed root metadata plus real PID/startticks exit checks; main must enumerate all actual owners and all existing sidecars.
A report can record partial/error/UNKNOWN; it cannot authorize continuation, resolve a hard UNKNOWN, or extend the Beta/training/global clock.

No existing runtime source, master, config, inventory, model, threshold, report or learning ledger is edited. Future six-model runtime remains unvalidated until actual execution and separate main review.
